rows.canonical: metaloop (trajctl meta-loop, fenced at one level)
rows.definition: The META LOOP at internal/trajctl/metaloop.go (#2567, epic #2533): the scorer-improvement objective closed at exactly one meta level. A base scoring method whose calibration drifts becomes a first-class trajctl Objective whose own W3 score is the calibration-delta (MetaScorerMethod="calibration-delta"), advancing from the baseline coefficient captured at declaration (MetaTarget). The one-level fence forbids anything from targeting the meta scorer itself (ErrMetaFence), enforced structurally at three places that cannot drift apart: MetaObjective construction, validateMetaTarget at the ledger boundary, and Calibrate skipping the meta method.
rows.distinction: NOT superloop (internal/superloop), which is recursive BY DESIGN - KindSuperloop is the descend out-edge in the composition graph, nesting super loops without bound; metaloop is the OPPOSITE - a recursion FORBIDDEN fence, exactly one meta level. NOT the calibration meter (internal/trajctl/calibration.go, #2566) it consumes - the meter MEASURES a base scorer's drift while metaloop DECLARES raising-that-calibration as an objective. NOT a regular trajctl Objective targeting a session/turn, and not loopdrive's GOAL.md witness loop (different domain).

rows.definition: The closed DOS refusal reason (dos.toml [reasons.STEER_NO_OWNED_LOOP], category MISROUTE, refusal=true) returned at gateway ingress (internal/gateway/http.go, writeErrCode 409, #3528) when a steer is POSTed to a session served on the default PROXY path - the proxy forwards a single upstream turn and owns no agent loop to drain the a2achan Session bus, so the steer could never be consumed. Refused rather than falsely acked as a phantom 202, so the caller learns the input will not land.
rows.distinction: NOT the agent-loop turn boundary itself (drainSteer at internal/agent/loop_session.go, #850) that CONSUMES a steer when an owned native loop (fak serve --native) is driving - STEER_NO_OWNED_LOOP is the closed reason naming that consumer's ABSENCE on the proxy path. NOT loopdrive (which iterates toward a GOAL.md witness), NOT superloop (which is an intent walker), and not a generic 'no loop' prose phrase - this is one closed-vocabulary DOS token.

rows.definition: The internal/repoguard classifier (internal/repoguard/foregroundloop.go, #4595) that returns FOREGROUND_NETWORK_LOOP Violations for a shell command whose `for x in <list>; do <network-call> $x; done` body makes one network round trip per item (gh/curl/wget, or git fetch/pull/push/clone/ls-remote) - scoped to for-loops (not while/until), skipped when backgrounded (`done &`), and never flagging the list-generating header call. Pure string work, hermetically testable; exported twin ClassifyForegroundNetworkLoop drives cmd/repoguard/main.go.
rows.distinction: NOT ReasonForegroundNetworkLoop (the const token NAME stamped into each Violation.Reason) - classifyForegroundNetworkLoop is the DETECTOR function, the const is the STAMP it produces. NOT loopdrive's iterating loop nor any agent-loop concept - this is the repoguard PreToolUse rung over SHELL for-loops, a different domain sharing only the spelling 'loop'.

rows.definition: The const string "FOREGROUND_NETWORK_LOOP" (internal/repoguard/foregroundloop.go, #4595) - the structured advisory reason stamped into each Violation.Reason produced by classifyForegroundNetworkLoop, consumed by severity.go (default SeverityWarn: the batch/background hint avoids a killed-mid-loop turn) and addressable by the per-reason override key FAK_REPO_GUARD_SEVERITY=FOREGROUND_NETWORK_LOOP=record|off, with FAK_REPO_GUARD=warn|off the master switch.
rows.distinction: NOT classifyForegroundNetworkLoop (the DETECTOR function that produces Violations carrying this reason) - ReasonForegroundNetworkLoop is the const NAME of the reason itself, the closed vocabulary token the severity table and the override env var key on. NOT a DOS refusal reason (those live in dos.toml; this is the repoguard in-process advisory vocabulary), and not an agent-loop concept.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak session-diagnosis struct type (cmd/fak/sessions_codex_loop.go:40) carrying ONE Codex session's verdict plus its evidence: session id, parent/originator, provider, guard witness, git commit/branch, started/last-event timestamps, final status/tokens/time, abort reason/duration, tool_calls/tool_outputs counts, repeated_outcomes, livelock_notices, and the verdict+reason+next_action+observability_gaps triad consumed by diagnoseCurrentCodexLoop, renderCodexLoopDiagnosis, and the codex-loop gate (codexLoopDiagnosisGateReason / codexLoopDiagnosisUnguarded).
rows.distinction: NOT codexLoopRecentReport (the BATCH-ROLLUP struct that folds MANY codexLoopDiagnosis rows into one `--recent` view with provider counts and loop/action/ok totals). NOT diagnoseCurrentCodexLoop (the FUNCTION that PRODUCES one codexLoopDiagnosis) - this is the DATA shape it returns; the function is already positioned as loop-diagnose-current-codexloop.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak batch-rollup struct type (cmd/fak/sessions_codex_loop.go:78) folding MANY recent codexLoopDiagnosis rows scanned under a codex-home (bounded by --since-hours/--limit) into one `--recent` report: counts (scanned/loop/action/ok/unguarded/guarded-loop/unguarded-loop/unknown-loop), provider_counts, tool_calls/tool_outputs totals, last_token_total_sum, top_repeated, and the verdict+reason+next_action aggregate consumed by diagnoseRecentCodexLoops, renderCodexLoopRecentReport, codexLoopFailOnRecentExitCode / codexLoopRecentGateReason, and the dispatch-tick codex gate.
rows.distinction: NOT codexLoopDiagnosis (the SINGLE-session struct that the rollup folds N of into its Diagnoses slice). NOT diagnoseRecentCodexLoops (the FUNCTION that PRODUCES one codexLoopRecentReport) - this is the DATA shape it returns; the function is already positioned as loop-diagnose-recent-codexloops.
